stage: Async geometric catch-up and online descriptor pose-domain repair
resource_scope: Sampled n3m process including startup, input, backlog drain and save; excludes FAST_LIO and recorder. Single runs, no repeatability interval.

descriptor_pose_domain_audit.scope: Observed blocking-run keyframe 170 optimized output versus its immutable raw odometry, expressed in newly inserted keyframe 171 raw root. No loop query occurs between 170 and 171. This quantifies mixed pose domains in descriptor construction, not a GT accuracy error.

schedule_stable_descriptor_serial_stable.scope: Same frozen frontend input; blocking diagnostic versus source-paced asynchronous candidate. Online publication delay remains real and is scored separately. This does not establish arbitrary-delay or multi-query snapshot invariance.

hall_05.scope: Direct prior ROS baseline versus final ROS candidate; unrelated frozen D stream is not assumed equal. PCL padding excluded, every declared field compared.

final_gate_schedule.scope: Full ROS asynchronous run versus blocking core control, same frozen frontend input if parity audit passes. Saved-map/measurement comparison only; online publication delay remains separately scored. Not arbitrary-schedule certification.

vector_clock.reference: Published Handsfree-to-Xsens relative rotation is identity; body angular increments cancel the unknown world orientation.
vector_clock.limits: Effective angular lag can include clock offset or orientation-filter latency; this audit cannot separate them. Angular agreement does not establish position timestamp, ECEF position reference point, GNSS lever-arm configuration, or absolute GT accuracy. No runtime, scorer or noise settings changed.

reference.inference: Published orientation behaves as local-up, while position is ECEF. Do not compose them into one SE3 pose without a verified world-frame conversion. Current positional scorer already ignores the GT quaternion.
reference.unresolved: The geometric extrinsics do not establish which physical point the exported Xsens positions represent. Native Xsens output configuration/lever-arm metadata is absent. Nominal scorer continues using the Xsens IMU point; antenna alternative remains diagnostic only.

endpoint_overlap.note: Endpoint-disjoint groups can still share temporal deskew/reference error; not an effective independent sample count.
Endpoint-disjoint groups can still share temporal deskew/reference error; not an effective independent sample count.
Endpoint-disjoint groups can still share temporal deskew/reference error; not an effective independent sample count.
Endpoint-disjoint groups can still share temporal deskew/reference error; not an effective independent sample count.

scalar.scope: Scalar marker-distance calibration only. All admitted runtime loops retained. GT-gap/near-zero-baseline exclusions affect observer labels only. Same-query edges carry total calibration weight 1; Shared match/query endpoints are grouped explicitly; no independent-sample confidence interval is claimed. No full-SE3 qualification or changed runtime weights; no GT in estimator.

robust_graph.scope: Observer-only existing Cauchy model (delta 1), frozen final graph. No edges removed or weights changed. Graph-conditioned central subset is a diagnostic, not an unbiased calibration set; all observable edges remain reported.

motion_proxy.scope: Observer-only scalar motion proxy; no runtime weight change. No independent-edge confidence intervals. Includes GT/interpolation and shared scan errors; does not qualify full SE(3) covariance or a physical clock parameter.

motion_time_holdout.scope: Observer-only same-route time holdout, not independent-route validation. Boundary-crossing edges remain in estimator and whole-route audit. Endpoint separation does not remove shared temporal/deskew/GT errors. No runtime calibration or independent-sample confidence claim.

unchanged_contracts: Original sensor payloads, FAST_LIO binary and parameters
Runtime timestamps, GT qualification gaps and fixed frontend-derived alignment
Loop admission thresholds, measurement information and robust Cauchy loss
Saved raw clouds/odometry, map format and optimized-map descriptor reconstruction
limitations: Online publication latency remains real; matched gate_02 controls do not certify arbitrary multi-query batch/snapshot schedules.

Final hall_05 frontend matches the actual prior ROS baseline, but differs from the older frozen D stream and the intermediate three-repair ROS run after frame 875. Those intermediate comparisons are not backend-only accuracy ablations.
Individual admitted pairs and per-frame errors can change. Aggregate improvement does not prove every prior observation was false or every new one is valid.
M2DGR native truth clock and reference-point configuration are missing. Effective angular lag is not a verified physical clock offset.
Full SE(3) uncertainty and transferable scalar coverage remain unqualified; observer fits are not runtime changes.
Universal 10 cm, real hardware, half-core mapping, and new map-extension/14-point replay qualification are not claimed by this six-route stage.
